title: Multimodal Industrial Inspection Assistant
business: Manufacturing firms performing quality control on assembly lines.
problem: Manual visual inspection of complex components is slow, error-prone, and lacks integration with historical technical documentation, leading to inconsistent defect detection.
solution: Implement a multimodal RAG system that ingests both high-resolution component images and technical PDF manuals, allowing the model to ground visual defect analysis in authoritative engineering specifications.
steps: Upload component images and technical manuals to Cloud Storage.
Use the Agent Platform Embeddings API to generate multimodal embeddings for both image and text data.
Index these embeddings into a Vector Search index for similarity matching.
Deploy a Cloud Run backend that retrieves relevant manual excerpts and visual reference samples based on a user query.
Synthesize the final inspection report using an LLM that processes the augmented multimodal context.
outcome: Improved consistency in defect identification by providing inspectors with real-time, context-aware guidance derived from both visual patterns and textual standards.
limitation: The system may experience latency spikes during high-volume visual ingestion; verify performance by monitoring query-response times in Cloud Monitoring.
